title: Social Life and Customs
summary: Manners and customs is for worldwide works. --Social life and customs is free-floating under regions, countries, cities, etc., classes of persons, ethnic groups (including Indians), and nationalities living outside their native country. It is never followed by --History. Under places it takes established chronological subdivisions or the free-floating century subdivisions --16th through --21st century; under classes of persons and ethnic groups only the free-floating century subdivisions are allowed.
validation_rules: `Manners and customs` is used for general works of worldwide scope not limited to a place or group. (H 2057 sec. 1)
`--Social life and customs` is free-floating under names of regions, countries, cities, etc. (H 2057 sec. 2)
Do not subdivide `[place]--Social life and customs`, `[class of persons]--Social life and customs`, or `[ethnic group]--Social life and customs` by `--History`. (H 2057 sec. 2, 3.a)

`[place]--Social life and customs` may be followed by established chronological subdivisions (e.g. `United States--Social life and customs--1971-`, `Japan--Social life and customs--1600-1868`) or by the free-floating century subdivisions `--16th century` through `--21st century` (H 1140), the latter only when not conflicting with established period subdivisions. (H 2057 sec. 2)
New period subdivisions under `[place]--Social life and customs` usually cover forty years or more. (H 2057 sec. 2)
`--Social life and customs` is free-floating under classes of persons and ethnic groups, including Indians. (H 2057 sec. 3.a)

Under `[class of persons]--Social life and customs` and `[ethnic group]--Social life and customs` use only the free-floating century subdivisions `--16th`, `--17th`, `--18th`, `--19th`, `--20th`, `--21st century` (H 1100, H 1103); do not establish other chronological subdivisions. (H 2057 sec. 3.a)

`--Social life and customs` is free-floating under nationalities residing outside their native country, with the place between, e.g. `Americans--France--Paris--Social life and customs`. (H 2057 sec. 3.b)
Customs of a nationality within its own country take `[place]--Social life and customs`, not `[nationality]--Social life and customs`. (H 2057 sec. 3.b)

sections.heading: 1. General
sections.text: Assign the heading Manners and customs to general works of worldwide scope on customs, ways of living, etc., not limited to a particular place or group of people.

sections.heading: 2. Places
sections.text:
Use the free-floating subdivision --Social life and customs under regions, countries, cities, etc., to works on the customs and habits of people in these places.

Do not subdivide headings of the type [place]--Social life and customs by --History.

Further subdivide headings of the type [place]--Social life and customs by established chronological subdivisions or by the free-floating century subdivisions listed under --Social life and customs in H 1140: --16th, [17th, 18th, 19th, 20th, or 21st] century. Assign century subdivisions only when they do not conflict with established subdivisions for specific time periods. Establish new subdivisions for other significant periods, usually covering forty years or more, under headings of the type [place]--Social life and customs where there is sufficient material to warrant it.

sections.heading: 3. Classes of persons and ethnic groups
a. General
sections.text:
Use the free-floating subdivision --Social life and customs under classes of persons and ethnic groups, including Indians, to works on the ways of living, customs, etc., of these classes or groups.

Do not subdivide headings of this type by --History.

Further subdivide headings of the type [class of persons]--Social life and customs and [ethnic group]--Social life and customs by the free-floating century subdivisions listed under --Social life and customs in H 1100 and H 1103: --16th, [17th, 18th, 19th, 20th, or 21st] century. Do not establish other chronological subdivisions under this type of heading.

sections.heading: b. Nationalities
sections.text:
Use the free-floating subdivision --Social life and customs under headings for nationalities to works on the customs of these groups when they reside outside their native countries, for example, Americans--France--Paris--Social life and customs.

To works on the customs of a nationality within its own country, assign a heading of the type [place]--Social life and customs.

sections.heading: 4. Examples
sections.text:
```
Title: Customs of the world : a popular account of the manners, rites, and ceremonies of men and women in all countries.
650 #0 $a Manners and customs.
650 #0 $a Rites and ceremonies.

Title: In pursuit of the American dream.
651 #0 $a United States $x Social life and customs $y 1971-

Title: Glimpses of old Japan.
651 #0 $a Japan $x Social life and customs $y 1600-1868.

Title: Indochinese in Lowell.
650 #0 $a Indochinese Americans $z Massachusetts $z Lowell $x Social life and customs.
651 #0 $a Lowell (Mass.) $x Social life and customs.

Title: We're Czechs.
650 #0 $a Czech Americans $z Texas $x Social life and customs.
650 #0 $a Farm life $z Texas.
651 #0 $a Texas $x Social life and customs.

Title: Social relations in Mendi.
650 #0 $a Mendi (Papua New Guinea people) $x Social life and customs.
650 #0 $a Ceremonial exchange $z Papua New Guinea.
651 #0 $a Papua New Guinea $x Social life and customs.
```
